answer_1.quote: Sequential neural network architectures ... have become the mainstay in abstractive summarization. We present a document hierarchy-aware graph neural network (HierGNN) ... that can be effectively incorporated into any sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) neural summarizer.

answer_4.guideline: Referees were asked to choose the best and worst summaries from the four candidates for each criterion.
